fields.description: Weekly issue featuring editorials and local commentary on Miami’s change from one-way to two-way downtown traffic and anticipated accidents; discussion of wages and working conditions including teacher pay in Dade County; coverage of Miami Beach civic concerns (street cleaning, sanitation, sewer cockroaches, and street obstructions); notes on policing of transients and crime; commentary on Florida politics including Governor John W. Martin and tourism; items on labor conflict involving the Capitol theatre and unions; and letters and reports concerning Florida Power & Light franchise disputes in Fort Myers. Includes extensive entertainment and nightlife listings and advertisements (theatres, night clubs, hotels), plus humorous racing/kennel-club material.
